posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
This is just a general thing with RPG Maker, that I have found weird for a couple of years now
With the RTP graphics...why wasn't there any shadows underneath the monsters and battlers? They don't feel like they're sitting ON the ground.
Heck, even the Charactersets.
They only addressed that after XP.
When you go into the game, the battlers almost look like a sticker.  :
I did a comic in artschool. Though I guess that's coming from my art background.
I had went and made RTP's with shadows, at least RTPS normal, then ones with shadows underneath them. But why didn't they do that? Seems like a weird thing to do for a company trying to make games.

Imo its not reasonable to expect them to go back and change the RTPs of the older engines to match the stylistic choices of newer ones. Same goes for any feature. Once they stop development of an older engine to start on a new one, Id expect that to be it - especially for software thats older than i am. IIrc ACE has a built in memory leak issue involving pictures that'll never be addressed officially

Theyre not the ones making the games. they make the tools for others to make games. They realistically cant do everything everyone asks for on every engine, which is why you can use your own assets for all of them and is why they made it easier to do other things like edit the game code in the later ones.
